cases.customer_question: What documentation is typically required to create a Bluetooth qualification compliance folder for a product registration?
question_variants: What files must be prepared for SIG registration?
cases.actual_issue: The customer needed to know which supporting documents must be collected and supplied for compliance-folder preparation associated with Bluetooth SIG registration.
cases.plain_english_explanation: Bluetooth registration projects often require a supporting compliance package that documents how the product implements Bluetooth technology. Several standard product documents are typically collected to support the registration record.
cases.consultant_answer: The consultant requested Bluetooth-related sections of the user manual, product block diagrams, product external drawings, and antenna documentation including radiation-gain information. These materials were identified as the required compliance-folder inputs for the registration project.
cases.decision_logic: Compliance documentation must provide sufficient evidence describing the product architecture, Bluetooth implementation, and antenna configuration used in the qualified design.
cases.final_recommendation: Collect Bluetooth user documentation, block diagrams, external drawings, and antenna performance documentation before registration completion so the compliance folder can be prepared without delay.
cases.risk_if_done_wrong: Missing compliance-folder documents can delay completion of the registration deliverables and supporting qualification records.
